claims.historical_statement: The complex higher-dimensional and polarized-surface companions use the corresponding nodal-bound, lattice-change and compression constructions with backward finite jet transfer; their maximality conclusions are downstream assertions, not hypotheses of this audit.
claims.supported_limited_statement: The named, hash-matched primary sources contain the corresponding nodal-envelope, lattice-coordinate and compression constructions, with their own finite-jet transfer statements. Their main maximality conclusions are not premises of this source trace.
claims.unresolved_mathematical_obligation: A textual dependency comparison is not a proof review of the universal construction or of the separate flag, saturation, interpolation, genericity and positivity/nefness implications. In particular, the surface injective full-polygon test is not the same statement as higher-dimensional surjective sparse-support reshaping.
claims.contribution_attribution: Reproduction and source attribution of constructions already present in the cited manuscripts; no new theorem or novelty claim.

historical_inputs.strongest_existing_prior_claim: dw<1/3 two-intercept reshaping with mixed-order maximum-rank transfer; assessed by other units, not re-proved here.

exact_supported_scope.positive_characteristic_target: 04-reshape.tex prop:reshape, lines 14-28: n>=2, positive real simplex intercepts, H=AB, d=max(3/A,2/B), w>0, dw<1/16, every positive degree, exact cardinality and gradedness, backward jet transfer.
exact_supported_scope.jet_conventions: 02-transfer.tex lines 11-48: algebraically closed k; that section works in every characteristic; J_y^m(A)=A_y/m_y^(m+1)A_y; surjectivity; for each N,r>=1,m>=0 some distinct k-torus tuple for the output implies one for the input, possibly a different tuple. This definition uses equal orders, not the old Argus mixed-order rank strengthening.
exact_supported_scope.actual_node: 04-reshape.tex lines 46-59,73-84: y^2+xy-x^3, roots 0,-1 and linear terms y,y+x, explicitly distinct/independent in characteristic two.
exact_supported_scope.compression: 02-transfer.tex lines 225-238,252-259: orders at z=1, unchanged labels, real interval bound, explicitly nonconsecutive orders including 0,p.
exact_supported_scope.complex_companion: Complex analytic y^2-x^2(1+x) construction in reshaping.tex with analytic finite-degree dependencies in transfers.tex; its auxiliary proposition allows n=2 but its main theorem is n>=3.
exact_supported_scope.surface_companion: Smooth integral complex projective surface, ample L, integral global nodal V in |dL|, H=L^2, section quadrilateral Q_t, full-polygon compression to P_t, backward injective order-m jets using O/m^m.

concrete_gaps: No second assessment of the PC universal nodal, transfer or composition proof is performed in this unit.
The source comparisons do not verify global surface nodal-divisor/intersection geometry or its uniform finite-subgroup interpolation and all-curves nefness argument.
Construction resemblance does not discharge any of the eight downstream/umbrella nodes itemized in downstream-boundaries.
Native independent Reviewer acceptance of coverage and the substantive mathematical assessments remains outstanding.
